LanguageData.LP_InstallBlindSight.label: install blind sight
LanguageData.LP_InstallBlindSight.description: A frost eye grown from a great deal of flesh. Replaces one eye, part efficiency 125%, grants the Ray of Frost: range 24 cells, 12 frostbite damage and +0.12 hypothermia, cooldown 8 seconds. Both eyes together give only one ability, with a shared cooldown.
LanguageData.LP_CraftBlindSight.label: grow blind sight
LanguageData.LP_CraftBlindSight.description: Grow blind sight from 400 fresh raw meat and metal auxiliaries. A frost eye grown from a great deal of flesh. Replaces one eye, part efficiency 125%, grants the Ray of Frost: range 24 cells, 12 frostbite damage and +0.12 hypothermia, cooldown 8 seconds. Both eyes together give only one ability, with a shared cooldown.
LanguageData.LP_InstallWitheringHand.label: install withering hand
LanguageData.LP_InstallWitheringHand.description: Replaces a whole arm, part efficiency 125%. After a melee attack deals effective damage, a living target gains +0.06 hypothermia; two arms don't trigger twice. Undead bodies and mechanoids are immune to hypothermia.
LanguageData.LP_CraftWitheringHand.label: grow withering hand
LanguageData.LP_CraftWitheringHand.description: Grow a withering hand from 600 fresh raw meat and metal auxiliaries. Replaces a whole arm, part efficiency 125%. After a melee attack deals effective damage, a living target gains +0.06 hypothermia; two arms don't trigger twice. Undead bodies and mechanoids are immune to hypothermia.
LanguageData.LP_InstallDeadPersonality.label: install necromantic sub-personality
LanguageData.LP_InstallDeadPersonality.description: An add-on brain implant that doesn't replace the brain. Removes the slowdown after daily XP reaches learning saturation and stops natural skill decay. Passion, learning multipliers, skill level caps and XP loss from other mechanics are kept.
LanguageData.LP_CraftDeadPersonality.label: grow necromantic sub-personality
LanguageData.LP_CraftDeadPersonality.description: Grow a necromantic sub-personality from 800 fresh raw meat and metal auxiliaries. An add-on brain implant that doesn't replace the brain. Removes the slowdown after daily XP reaches learning saturation and stops natural skill decay. Passion, learning multipliers, skill level caps and XP loss from other mechanics are kept.
LanguageData.LP_InstallShadowLeg.label: install shadow walk
LanguageData.LP_InstallShadowLeg.description: Replaces a whole leg, part efficiency 135%. Once installed, permanently passes through walls: normal walking and work pathfinding can pass through walls, mountain rock and doors without damaging buildings. Can't cross impassable water or the void or walk off the map, and can't use a spot inside a wall as a work destination.
LanguageData.LP_CraftShadowLeg.label: grow shadow walk
LanguageData.LP_CraftShadowLeg.description: Grow shadow walk from 600 fresh raw meat and metal auxiliaries. Replaces a whole leg, part efficiency 135%. Once installed, permanently passes through walls: normal walking and work pathfinding can pass through walls, mountain rock and doors without damaging buildings. Can't cross impassable water or the void or walk off the map, and can't use a spot inside a wall as a work destination.
LanguageData.LP_RemoveDeadPersonality.label: remove necromantic sub-personality
LanguageData.LP_RemoveDeadPersonality.description: Remove the necromantic sub-personality and recover the implant.
